title: qxmd209: Marks footer Prev|Check|Next only on all practice paths
body: Root cause: NEET/Medical chapter practice used AllenTestUI.practiceHtml (and app.js fallback) with Show Answer|Clear|Prev|Next strip and Check Answer outside the fixed bar. Lock Marks one-row Previous|Check Answer|Next on allen + fallback; keep examgoal path; keep qxmd208 stem-rescue guards.
